content:
FINAL MEMBER REGISTRATION RECOVERY — EXECUTE END TO END

PRIORITY: P0
MODE: EXECUTE, REPAIR, TEST, DEPLOY, VERIFY
SCOPE: MEMBER REGISTRATION ONLY

DO NOT RETURN ANOTHER GENERAL REPORT.
DO NOT ASK ME TO PASTE SECRETS IN CHAT.
USE THE SECURE CREDENTIALS FORM OR EXISTING OWNER VAULT.

OBJECTIVE

Complete Member Registration end to end with:

- canonical GitHub branch and PR
- CI PASS
- Render deployment
- Supabase availability
- real email/SMS OTP delivery
- Supabase session creation
- IVX Home redirect
- production evidence

==================================================
STEP 1 — RESTORE GITHUB AND RENDER EXECUTION ACCESS
==================================================

Use the secure owner credential flow.

Required GitHub capability:

- repository read/write
- branch creation
- commit/push
- pull-request creation
- GitHub Actions read
- workflow execution
- CI result inspection

Required Render capability:

- service read
- deployment trigger
- deployment-status read
- deployed commit SHA read

Do not expose secret values.

Return:

GITHUB_AUTH: PASS/FAIL
RENDER_AUTH: PASS/FAIL

If either fails, return only:

- exact missing credential
- exact secure configuration location
- exact permission missing
- exact owner action

Do not continue to deployment until both pass.

==================================================
STEP 2 — DIAGNOSE SUPABASE HTTP 503
==================================================

Do not rotate the Supabase service-role key unless evidence proves it is invalid.

A 503 means the service is unavailable, overloaded, paused, unreachable, or misconfigured.

Check:

1. Supabase project status.
2. API availability.
3. Database availability.
4. Auth availability.
5. Connection limits.
6. Paused/inactive project state.
7. Region or network incident.
8. Render-to-Supabase connectivity.
9. DNS resolution.
10. Timeout and retry behavior.
11. Project URL correctness.
12. Service-role key configuration without exposing it.

Run safe probes:

- Supabase REST health/read probe
- Auth health probe
- database connection probe
- Render outbound connectivity probe

Return:

- exact failing endpoint
- HTTP status
- response body summary
- whether failure is Supabase, Render network, DNS, timeout, or configuration
- corrective action
- retest result

Do not classify 503 as a credential failure without proof.

==================================================
STEP 3 — REPAIR MEMBER REGISTRATION CODE
==================================================

Use only:

Repository:
ibb142/ivx-holdings-platform

Production branch:
main

Create a clean authenticated clone of main.

Create branch:

fix/member-registration-live-final

Implement Phase 1 fields:

Required:

- first name
- last name
- date of birth
- mobile phone
- email
- password
- confirm password
- terms/privacy acceptance

Optional:

- gender

Remove from required Phase 1:

- ZIP
- role
- investment interests
- investor classification
- KYC/AML
- identity documents
- tax information
- bank information
- source of funds

==================================================
STEP 4 — REAL OTP DELIVERY
==================================================

Email:

- use configured AWS SES or approved provider
- deliver OTP
- capture provider message ID
- never return OTP in API response
- never log OTP

SMS:

- use configured AWS SNS or approved provider
- normalize phone to E.164
- deliver OTP
- capture provider message ID
- never return OTP in API response
- never log OTP

If AWS credentials were previously exposed:

- rotate them through the owner-controlled AWS account
- update Render securely
- verify SES/SNS access
- never print keys

==================================================
STEP 5 — SECURE OTP STORAGE
==================================================

- store only hashed OTP
- short expiration
- resend cooldown
- maximum attempts
- replay prevention
- invalidate old OTP after resend
- invalidate OTP after success
- rate-limit email, phone, account and IP
- remove plaintext fallback storage

Add tests for:

- valid OTP
- wrong OTP
- expired OTP
- reused OTP
- resend invalidation
- excessive attempts
- excessive resend
- concurrent verification

==================================================
STEP 6 — ACCOUNT AND SESSION COMPLETION
==================================================

After successful OTP verification:

1. Create or confirm Supabase Auth user.
2. Create exactly one member profile.
3. Prevent duplicate email and phone.
4. Create Supabase session.
5. Store refresh session securely.
6. Redirect to IVX Home.
7. Confirm app restart preserves session.
8. Confirm logout clears session.
9. Confirm investor KYC is not required to browse.

Do not report registration success based only on a database row.

==================================================
STEP 7 — TEST BEFORE DEPLOYMENT
==================================================

Run:

- TypeScript
- lint
- backend unit tests
- registration integration tests
- Supabase auth tests
- OTP security tests
- SES test delivery
- SNS test delivery
- Android registration flow
- iOS registration flow
- web registration flow
- session persistence
- duplicate prevention
- weak-network recovery
- app-restart recovery
- secret scan

Use approved test identities only.

==================================================
STEP 8 — PR, CI AND MERGE
==================================================

- commit only member-registration changes
- push branch
- open PR into main
- run required CI
- repair failures caused by the PR
- merge only after required checks pass and approval exists

Return:

- branch
- commit SHA
- PR URL
- CI run IDs
- merge SHA

==================================================
STEP 9 — RENDER DEPLOYMENT
==================================================

After merge:

1. Trigger Render deployment.
2. Capture deployment ID.
3. Wait for LIVE.
4. Capture deployed SHA.
5. Verify /health HTTP 200.
6. Verify /version HTTP 200.
7. Verify production registration endpoints.

Required equality:

GitHub main SHA
=
CI-tested SHA
=
Render deployed SHA
=
/health SHA
=
/version SHA

==================================================
STEP 10 — LIVE END-TO-END PROOF
==================================================

Run one production-safe registration using approved test email and phone.

Prove:

- member form accepts only Phase 1 fields
- OTP email delivered
- OTP SMS delivered
- OTP values not exposed
- Supabase Auth user created
- one member profile created
- authenticated session created
- IVX Home redirect works
- app restart preserves session
- no investor KYC required
- test account is clearly labeled and safely removable

Return evidence:

- job ID
- trace ID
- GitHub main SHA
- CI-tested SHA
- PR URL
- merge SHA
- Render deployment ID
- Render SHA
- /health SHA
- /version SHA
- SES message ID
- SNS message ID
- Supabase user ID masked
- member record ID masked
- session result
- redirect result
- Android result
- iOS result
- web result
- completion timestamp

FINAL STATUS MUST BE EXACTLY ONE:

MEMBER_REGISTRATION_LIVE_VERIFIED

or

MEMBER_REGISTRATION_NOT_VERIFIED

If NOT VERIFIED, list only:

- exact blocker
- exact service
- exact owner action
- evidence

START WITH STEP 1.
CONTINUE STEP BY STEP.
DO NOT STOP AFTER DIAGNOSIS.
